indian_entity: Muslim burial at Panthalayani Kollam, Malabar Coast
chinese_source: Arabic tombstone inscription outside the Juma mosque, Panthalayani Kollam (local epigraphy as reported in the Kerala survey literature)
event: Tombstone records the death of a Muslim (ibn Udthorman) in Hijra 166 — a Muslim buried on the Malabar coast, implying a burying community
firmness_reason: Reading circulates through secondary survey literature, not a modern epigraphic edition; AH 166 = 782-783 CE (repeatedly misprinted as '752 CE' in the secondary literature — a conversion error)
notes: If the reading holds, this is the earliest dated Muslim presence on the coast, two-thirds of a century before the Quilon plates. Grade is explicitly hostage to a critical re-edition of the stone.
references: Malabar Muslims / Mappila survey literature on the Panthalayani tombstone
Heritage: Journal of Multidisciplinary Studies in Archaeology 8.1 (2020) — prints the erroneous '752 CE' conversion
